lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A sparse distribution of approximately six high-luminance, roughly circular clusters is visible across the mid-lateral flank, arranged in a non-linear, staggered formation posterior to the gill region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient where high-intensity light-gray pixels on the dorsal edge transition abruptly to deep-shadowed pixels on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, dark linear indentation or elongated scar is visible on the lower lateral flank, running parallel to the primary ridge and extending approximately one-third of the visible body length.
other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elliptical focal point resembling a pit or deep pigmentation mark is visible on the far posterior portion of the visible flank, contrasting sharply with the lighter surrounding dermis.
